# Image Preparation Guide

All images are auto-generated by `generate_app_images.py` (run via `build-manual.sh`).

## Auto-generated images

These are generated from real application code — plugin cards match exactly what appears on the device:

| File | Source | Content |
|------|--------|---------|
| `plugins.jpg` | `plugins/morning_briefing` | Morning Briefing card (PIL, real app code) |
| `weather.jpg` | `plugins/weather` | Weather detail card (HTML, rendered via Chrome) |
| `evening.jpg` | `plugins/evening_card` | Evening card (PIL, real app code) |
| `interrupt.jpg` | PIL mock (app style) | Calendar/weather interrupt notification |
| `dashboard.jpg` | PIL mock (app style) | Phone web UI — clock, status, schedule |
| `schedule.jpg` | PIL mock (app style) | Phone settings — schedule editor |

## Physical photos needed (placeholders auto-created)

Take these yourself and replace the placeholder JPGs:

| File | What to shoot | Orientation |
|------|--------------|-------------|
| `hero.jpg` | InkyPi on stand in a room setting (living room, desk, or kitchen) | Landscape |
| `contents.jpg` | All box contents laid out flat | Landscape |
| `parts.jpg` | Close-up of device front with numbered callouts | Portrait |
| `setup.jpg` | Device on stand with USB cable plugged in | Landscape |

## Regeneration

```sh
python3 docs/generate_app_images.py
```

## Post-processing for physical photos

1. Crop each image to remove unnecessary background.
2. JPEG quality 85% is sufficient for print.
3. For callouts on `parts.jpg`, use image editing software to add numbered circles.
